description: Write any date in Roman numerals — day, month and year converted with proper subtractive notation.

faqs.a: Yes — subtractive notation is used throughout: 4 = IV, 9 = IX, 40 = XL, 90 = XC, 400 = CD, 900 = CM.
faqs.q: Does it use subtractive notation (IV not IIII)?

faqs.a: Standard Roman numerals cover 1–3999, so any realistic calendar year works. Years above 3999 have no standard form.
DD · MM · YYYY, e.g. 14-02-2026 becomes XIV · II · MMXXVI.
